#### **<u>Highlights</u>** 

##### **How much effects on copper concentrate processing trade by policy adjustment?** 

The Ministry of Finance and State Administration of Taxation have issued a Notice Concerning Value Added Tax and Consumption Tax on Export Goods and Services (Finance and Tax (2012) No.39) recently. According to the Notice, the 3% tariff on copper concentrate for processing trade will be cancelled, while a 17% value added tax will be imposed instead. Currently, the detailed operation regulations have not released. 

Based on current LME copper price at USD 7,500/t and 2012 long-term contract TC/RC at USD 60/t (Cent 6.0/lbs), total tax imposed on copper concentrate processors will be around 400yuan/t if the 17% VAT is imposed, which is about1000yuan/t lower than tax unadjusted. 

Processing trade refers to the business activity of importing raw materials and

components from abroad and re-exporting finished products after processing. At present, domestic consumption is weak, and SHFE/LME copper price ratio is still unfavorable for import. Processing trade method for Chinese copper smelters is one good way to avoid market risks. China has adjusted tax policy for copper concentrate processing for several times and the details are as follows: 

At the start of 2006, China imposed restrictions on processing trade on certain high-polluting, high energy consuming and resource-intensive products, including copper concentrate. Since then, China started imposing 10% tariffs on exports of refined copper and 13% value-added tariffs on imports of copper concentrate. As a result, annual imported copper concentrate through processing trade method decreased to 87.88kt in 2007 from 565kt in 2006. With regards to processing trade proportion, copper concentrate import through processing trade accounted for around 16% in 2006, while 2% in 2007. 

Since Feb, 1, 2009, imports policy for copper ore and concentrate was adjusted to only 7 specific firms permitted to do copper concentrate processing trade, with other firms still restricted. These 7 firms included Jiangxi Copper, Yunnan Copper, Daye Nonferrous, Tongling Nonferrous, Jingchuan Group, Baiyin Nonferrous and Shandong Xiangguan. Export volume of the year was set to be 20%-30% of total imported copper concentrate last year. Since then, processing trade for copper concentrate resumed at a certain degree, but profit margin was narrowing due to unfavorable SHFE/LME price ratio and Chinese smelters bore huge risks due to huge fluctuating copper prices. 

According to Antaike’s survey, the policy adjustment will only make effects on Chinese several large smelters, while who have no big changes on copper concentrate trade temporarily. In the long term, smelters will adjust trade volume according to SHFE/LME price ratio, margin and domestic refined copper demand.

#### **Copper Market Commentary** 

##### **Copper prices go stable and rebound in August** 

After entering August, LME copper prices went steady after falling in the middle of July. In August, average copper price of LME cash month and 3-month were USD7,492/t and USD7,501/t, with a month on month decline of 1.28% and 1.17% and year on year fall of 17.13% and17.22%, respectively. 

LME copper stocks continued to decline recently, with 13kt cut down from about 249kt in the end of July. Cancelled warrants were still at a high level of 43kt, accounting for 18.3% of the total stocks. There are still falling spaces in next few months for copper stocks on LME. But the only falling stocks were not enough to bring copper price going up, due to low expectations for future fundamentals. 

Domestic copper price rebounded in August and rushed to around 56,000yuan/t in late August. In August, average copper price of SHFE cash month and 3-month were

55,520yuan/t and 55,146yuan/t, with month on month rise of 0.06% and decline of 0.49%, and year on year fall of 18.57% and18.48%, respectively. 

HSBC's China's manufacturing activity fell to 47.6 in August, hitting the lowest since March of 2009. Anything below 50 indicates overall activity is contracting. Domestic demand was still sluggish. Under this situation, enterprises were facing great business pressure. 

From a technical point of view, average line system below provided support for price but above facing pressure from high point formed before. It is estimated that LME 3-month price will fluctuate between USD7,600/t and USD8,200/t, with average price in the range of USD7,650/t and USD7,750/t. SHFE 3-month copper price will fluctuate between 55,500 yuan/t and 59,500 yuan/t, with average price in the range of 56,000 yuan/t and 57,000 yuan/t.

##### **Chinese refined copper production has a month on month decline** 

According to data from China Nonferrous metals Industry Association (CNIA), domestic refined copper output was 459kt, down by 6.9% m-o-m or up by 1.5% y-o-y; refined copper output amounted to 3.22Mt during Jan to Jul, up by 9.1% y-o-y. Data released by the NBS showed that refined copper output decreased by 6.8% m-o-m to 483kt in July, with y-o-y rise of 0.8%; refined copper output amounted to 3.40Mt during Jan to July, up by 9.2% y-o-y. Besides, according to Antaike’s statistics, copper cathode output of domestic 12 enterprises reached 330.8kt in July, up by 0.99% m-o-m; copper cathode output of domestic 12 enterprises amounted to 2.32Mt during Jan to Jul, up by 4.25% y-o-y. Among them, copper cathode output in Jiangxi Copper, Tongling Nonferrous, Jinchuang Group and Yunnan Copper accounted for 27.69%, 20.85%, 15.60% and 9.23%, respectively. Above data shows that data from the CNIA and NBS have larger growth rate compared with that by Antaike. With the overhauling works gradually end in some smelters of northern China, refined copper output will go stable and up slightly in next two months. 

Data released by the CNIA still showed that copper semis output reached 957kt in July, down by 11.1% m-o-m or up by 7.4% y-o-y; copper semis output reached 6.36Mt during Jan to Jul, with a year on year rise of 9.8%. Data reflected a decline trend for copper consumption.

##### **Chinese refined copper imports have m-o-m rise in July, but exports stay high** 

According to the data released by China’s Customs, refined copper import reached 254kt in July, up by 1.7% m-o-m and 30.9% y-o-y; refined copper import amounted to 2.14Mt during Jan to July, up by 67.1% y-o-y. The m-o-m rise of chinese refined copper import was a little unexpected, mainly due to unfavorable price ratio between SHFE and LME, financing copper limited by Chinese banks and no signs of impr

oving copper demand in domestic copper market. With regards to the purpose of refined copper import, financing copper still existed and some fixed-term contract driven import volume in July. Refined copper import volume will keep at this kind of level in the near future. 

Refined copper export was 13kt in July, down by 64.8% m-o-m and up by 230.5% y-o-y. Refined copper export amounted to 205kt during Jan to Jul, up by 36.0% y-o-y. The m-o-m fall was within the expected with gradual end of entrepot trade in Chinese enterprises in May and June. But refined copper export was expected to rise due to the cancellation of 3% tariff on copper concentrate for processing trade in the near future. 

Copper concentrate import was 566kt in July, up by 17.8% m-o-m and 25.2% y-o-y; copper concentrate import amounted to 3.95Mt during Jan to Jul, up by 16.3% y-o-y. 

Copper scrap import was 429kt in July, at a m-o-m rise of 16.2% and y-o-y decline of 0.8%; copper scrap import amounted to 2.65Mt during Jan to Jul, up by 1.0% y-o-y. Antaike estimates that copper scrap import has a certain space to rise in next two months driven by current rising copper price.

##### **Copper consumption** 

According to data from the NBS, most copper end-using copper products output decreased during Jan to Jul, except output of power cable, generating capacity, transformer, household ice-box and autos had year on year rise. Above data showed that such traditional copper consuming sectors, as electric power industry and air conditioning industry still barely supported Chinese copper consumption. It is not to be neglected that growth rate of air conditioner output has been obviously slowed down. During Jan to Jul of 2012, growth rate of air conditioner output decreased by 1.5% y-o-y, while at a year on year rise of 41.6% in the same period of 2011. So, air conditioning industry won’t give much support for copper consumption in the future. 

According to data from China Electricity Council, during Jan to Jul, the completed power investment was 338 billion yuan, up by 1.48% y-o-y. Among them, investment in power grid rose by 6.85% y-o-y to 166.9 billion yuan and investment in power generation reached 171 billion yuan, down by 3.27% y-o-y.

Investment in thermal power accounted for 28% of total power generation investment, 4.1 percentage points lower that the same period of 2011. Investment share in hydropower, nuclear power and wind power increased to 71% around against 2011. 

During Jan to Jul, investment in domestic real estate development was 3.68 trillion yuan, nominal up by 15.4% y-o-y, 1.2 percentage points lower than that in Jan to Jun. Among them, investme

nt in residential houses was 2.52 trillion yuan, up by 10.7% y-o-y, 1.3 percentage points lower than that in Jan to Jun, accounting for 68.6% of the total investment in real estate. During Jan to Jul, floor space under construction was 4,892.16 mln sq.m, up by 15.3% y-o-y, 1.9 percentage points lower than that in Jan to Jun. Of them, floor space under construction of residential houses was 3,673.74 mln sq.m, at a rise of 13.0% y-o-y. Starting floor space of houses was 1,039.05 mln sq.m, down by 9.8% y-o-y, of which starting floor space of residential houses was 771.40 mln sq.m, down by 13.4% y-o-y. Completion floor space of houses was 386.08 mln sq.m, up by 19.0% y-o-y, 1.7 percentage points lower than that in Jan to Jun, of which completion floor space of residential houses was 309.52 mln sq.m, up by 19.0% y-o-y. On the whole, obvious growth slowdown in real estate industry gave a certain pressure on copper consumption. Data trend of Chinese real estate industry have some influence on copper prices although it is not important copper consuming sector in China. ### **Industrial News** 

**Dexing Mine’s sulfuric acid project passes a trial run successfully** 

JCC Dexing Mine’s 300ktpy pyrite Circular economic project passed a successful trial run on August 8, 2012. The whole project, with the total capacity of 600ktpy, was built by two stages, with total investment of 546 million yuan in stage1. After completion of stage 1, the project can produce sulfuric acid (98%) of 250ktpy, 150ktpy sulfuric acid fuming and 18ktpy high quality iron powder. Besides, power generation by waste heat will reach 78 million Kwh. 

The project uses sulphur concentrates as raw materials which are by products from Dexing Mine, adopting boiling-bed roasting process and two conversions and two absorptions process.
